_comment: BackDown UI strings as they appear in the landing-page screenshots. 'exact': a whole text node (trimmed) -> its translation, numbers already localised. 'patterns': [regex matched against the English text node, replacement using $1..$n]; numbers inside the groups are localised automatically by capture.mjs using 'locale'. Keep paths, drive names and folder names untranslated. Patterns are tried in order, so specific ones must precede general ones. Optional 'suffixes' maps the app's K/M count suffixes to the locale's abbreviations.

exact.what a full de-duplication would free: what a full de-duplication would free
exact.All mail in the vmail tree: All mail in the vmail tree
Click a drive to jump to its size tree.
exact.Click a row to expand. Bars are relative: Click a row to expand. Bars are relative to the parent. Orange marks directories over 1 TB.
exact.Pairs of directories (depth 2) sharing f: Pairs of directories (depth 2) sharing files by name + size, files ≥ 1 MB. Name + size is the cheap first pass; the hash-proven view is in
exact.Every file on the small drives was sha25: Every file on the small drives was sha256-hashed, then matched against hashed twins on the 18 TB drive.
exact.= an identical file exists on the big dr: = an identical file exists on the big drive.
exact.= no identical file anywhere else; must: = no identical file anywhere else; must be copied before the drive is wiped.
exact.Nothing is wiped until every file has a: Nothing is wiped until every file has a sha256-verified copy. Hashing is complete on all drives; the 'copy first' sizes are the exact unique bytes.
exact.Every file has a sha256-identical copy o: Every file has a sha256-identical copy on ARCHIVE-18TB: 310 GB in 402 K files, all verified.
exact.81% verified. 212 GB exists nowhere else: 81% verified. 212 GB exists nowhere else (Photos/2019–2021 RAW 188 GB, Videos 24 GB): copy those, then wipe.
exact.99.1% verified. 4.2 GB in 11 K files is: 99.1% verified. 4.2 GB in 11 K files is unique (Documents 3.1 GB, dotfiles, ssh keys): copy those, then wipe.
exact.Hashing is 64% done. The verdict follows: Hashing is 64% done. The verdict follows once every file has been hashed.
exact.Wiped after verification; now holds an o: Wiped after verification; now holds an offline mirror of Archive/Mail.
exact.First level = type of thing, second = or: First level = type of thing, second = origin (host / person / company), third = time. One authoritative copy on the 18 TB drive; freed drives become mirrors of the irreplaceable subset.
exact.all IMAP/maildir data, by server then do: all IMAP/maildir data, by server then domain
exact.Copying every small-drive file that has: Copying every small-drive file that has no sha256 twin on the 18 TB drive into
exact., layout preserved. Journaled rsync — re: , layout preserved. Journaled rsync — re-running resumes.
exact.Second copies of the irreplaceable subse: Second copies of the irreplaceable subset on the freed drives: mail as per-mailbox
exact.packed across BD-1T-A/B/C; Archive subse: packed across BD-1T-A/B/C; Archive subset → BD-500; Photos → BD-1T-C.
